reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Bazel representative release artifact outputs and artifact metadata comparison helpers
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare artifact kind, product identity, package member names, resource presence, signing mode names, status class, and provenance metadata; exclude binary payload bytes and signing material from local evidence.
required_non_local_evidence: release-candidate artifact metadata comparison artifact from an approved CI or release environment
reference-only guarded CMake/Python package status evidence when bootstrap prerequisites are available

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: generated resources, translations, fonts, icons, littlefs images, WUI assets, ESP blobs, language packs, and generated headers
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Bazel generated drift registry and Phase 7 generated-output ownership manifest
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare generator identity, declared source ownership, check/update label coverage, tracked output names, and resource package metadata; keep full generator byte comparisons in CI or release evidence.
required_non_local_evidence: CI generated-output drift report for source-writing and byte-oriented generators
release-candidate resource package comparison artifact

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: persistent config, deprecated item IDs, defaults, credentials by name, journal hash, and storage migration fixtures
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Phase 7 storage/resource manifests plus Rust storage compatibility contracts
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare schema IDs, migration window names, defaults, deprecated-key identities, redacted credential key names, journal hash facts, and storage-surface names; do not store credential values or raw EEPROM bytes.
required_non_local_evidence: simulator or hardware storage migration run against approved redacted fixtures
storage media timing evidence for USB, internal flash, and semihosting paths

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: protocol traces from reference capture, Connect/WUI command fixtures, and auxiliary transport traces by name
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Phase 9 network contracts, Phase 10 auxiliary controller contracts, and guarded reference trace contracts
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare protocol state names, command IDs, trace fixture identities, response status classes, transport surface names, and retained error classes; keep live trace logs redacted and attached outside the manifest.
required_non_local_evidence: simulator protocol trace comparison artifact for Connect/WUI and transfer flows
hardware or simulator auxiliary transport trace artifact for RS485/MMU/toolchanger paths

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: G-code behavior fixtures and Buddy-specific G/M-code routing fixtures
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Phase 6 printing-core contracts and Rust print domain routing surfaces
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare fixture IDs, command mnemonics, route classifications, planner-visible state names, and accepted intentional-delta names; leave physical motion, thermal, and safety outcomes to simulator or hardware evidence.
required_non_local_evidence: simulator G-code behavior fixture comparison artifact
hardware smoke evidence for motion, thermal, emergency, and recovery behavior

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: GUI workflow and display-state fixtures for 240x320 and 480x320 surfaces
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Phase 8 GUI workflow manifest and Rust GUI display/evidence contracts
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare workflow row IDs, display class names, semantic action IDs, layout/localization surface names, and source-backed state labels; keep pixel, touch, encoder, and long-run rendering proof outside local manifest evidence.
required_non_local_evidence: simulator display-state fixture comparison artifact for 240x320 and 480x320 flows
hardware smoke or manual display interaction evidence for LCD, touch, encoder, and long-run UI behavior

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: Connect, WUI, TLS, API, telemetry, transfer, and local service behavior
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Phase 9 Connect/WUI/transfer manifests, negative fixtures, and Rust network contracts
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare endpoint family names, auth mode names, TLS policy labels, command state names, telemetry/event surfaces, transfer state classes, and negative fixture IDs; store only approved redacted evidence references.
required_non_local_evidence: live Connect or approved service-compatible API evidence with redacted credential identities
real TLS handshake and custom certificate fixture evidence
simulator or hardware transfer/network fault-injection evidence

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: puppy, Dwarf, ModularBed, xBuddy Extension, MMU2, Modbus/RS485, toolchanger, and update flows
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Phase 10 auxiliary controller manifests and Rust auxiliary domain contracts
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare controller kind names, runtime state names, firmware source identities, Modbus request classes, MMU transport surface names, dock/tool-offset identities, and update mode labels; do not store firmware image bytes.
required_non_local_evidence: RS485/Modbus hardware-smoke or simulator-flow comparison artifact
live MMU transport evidence
toolchanger and auxiliary update hardware evidence

reference_comparisons.reference_surface: release metadata, package status, provenance, and signing-sensitive status names
reference_comparisons.rust_or_bazel_surface: Bazel package status manifests, artifact metadata comparison helper, and guarded release reference contracts
reference_comparisons.normalization_rule: Compare release status names, artifact kind names, product/profile provenance, unsigned-local versus signing-sensitive mode names, package member identities, and CI artifact metadata; exclude signing key material and firmware package bytes from checked-in evidence.
required_non_local_evidence: release-candidate metadata comparison artifact from an approved release environment
signing-sensitive status evidence recorded by name only
